Intel’s days away case rate remained flat from 2010 to 2011, and our recordable rate 
for injury and illness was up 7% over 2010 levels. 
health and Safety management Systems
Since 2010, Intel has maintained company-wide certification for OHSAS 
18001, the internationally recognized standard for occupational safety  
and health management systems. As a result, Intel now maintains a fully 
integrated multi-site registration to both ISO 14001 and OHSAS 18001 
that extends through December 31, 2013. In 2011, we did not receive  
any safety-related notices of violation as a result of EHS regulatory visits 
or audits.
